ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Finance, Actuarial Science, 1st Stage Accountancy, and Agri-Finance majors thru Nov 29. (Dual degree students who are declared Accountancy will NOT receive registration priority.) Any remaining seats will open to other College of Business students at approximately noon on Monday, Nov. 30. If any seats remain on Monday, January 11, they will open to College of Engineering and LAS Economics students at that time. Prerequisite (FIN 221) will be enforced. Students who have not completed FIN 221 will be removed from FIN 300.
